question: Does the GAP between price-position and CVD-position carry information the current two-threshold rule misses?
why_it_exists: The operator asked for worked examples and produced 65·10 — a 55-point disagreement that the shipped rule IGNORES, because bearish requires px>=85 and bullish requires px<=15. The widest divergence of the four he named gets no colour at all. He found the hole by asking for examples, not by testing.

frozen.gap_threshold_provenance: NOT FITTED. It is the minimum gap the ALREADY-SHIPPED rule implies: bearish fires at px>=85 with cvd<=50 (gap 35) and bullish at px<=15 with cvd>=50 (gap 35). Adopting the incumbent's own geometry means no threshold was selected by looking at data. DO NOT TUNE IT — a change restarts the count at zero.
frozen.direction: px_pos > cvd_pos => BEARISH lean (price ahead of the buying). px_pos < cvd_pos => BULLISH lean.
frozen.unit_of_observation: EPISODE, never a minute. A gap persists for many consecutive minutes; counting minutes would score one divergence forty times and inflate n by the length of the episode rather than the number of them.
frozen.episode: a contiguous run of minutes with |px_pos - cvd_pos| >= 35 and a constant sign; it ends when the gap closes below 35 or the sign flips
frozen.entry_point: the FIRST minute of the episode — the moment the rule would have spoken
frozen.outcome: forward price change from the episode's first minute, SIGNED BY THE LEAN (bearish lean scores a fall as positive)
frozen.range_anchor: ROLLING 180 MINUTES, for BOTH price and CVD
frozen.range_anchor_why: A session anchor spans up to 24h, so a US-hours reading is taken against overnight Asia extremes; and it only ever GROWS, so the gauge loses resolution as the day ages. 180 min chosen from mechanism — it spans a full leg (his median leg is 43min) without reaching into the previous session — NOT from any measured result.
frozen.cvd_level_is_unchanged: The CVD NUMBER stays session-cumulative — that is the meaning he has learned. Only the SCALE it is placed on rolls. Rolling the level too would silently redefine the number under him.
frozen.window_is_taken_as_it_was: At minute m the window is the preceding 180 minutes and nothing after. Slicing from a finished curve would be a look-ahead.

comparisons_required: CONTROL: every minute, same race, no signal — the base rate the whole thing must beat
INCUMBENT: the shipped two-threshold rule (px>=85 & cvd<=50, px<=15 & cvd>=50) scored on the SAME episodes
verdict_rule: The GAP rule must beat BOTH the control AND the incumbent on median signed forward move, with NON-OVERLAPPING DAY-CLUSTERED bootstrap CIs. ⚠ Beating the control while merely matching the incumbent is REFUTED — the incumbent already ships, and replacing it with something indistinguishable is churn.
in_sample_status: NONE for this rule. ⚠ CORRECTION: the superseded session-anchored version HAD already collected 25 episodes before it was replaced — an earlier draft of this file wrongly said zero. They are archived at data/gap_log_session_anchored.jsonl.superseded, NOT deleted, and MUST NOT be counted toward this registration: they were produced by a different rule. The 5 sessions of tick history remain spent on the PULSE/FLOW study.
observed_rate: ~18 episodes/session with the rolling window (was ~24 session-anchored)
\u26a0 nothing depends on this: The gauges and the colour ship as they are. This tests only whether the GAP should replace the two thresholds as the flag's trigger.
\u26a0 a false statement was caught in t: The first draft asserted 'nothing had been collected'. It was written from an `ls` that had failed moments earlier, not from a check that succeeded — the same shape of error as grepping an empty file for failures and reading zero as green. 25 episodes existed. Corrected before the file was committed.
